scope: Expanded semantic-world and counter-example supervision pre-registration for the neural memory line: 24 new worlds (12 train / 6 dev / 6 test, world-level split) with fresh people/city inventories disjoint from JB-001, bilingual, 8 scenarios per (world, relation, language) group. Zero training, no model forward, no serving.

wrong_time.facts: target current + distractor; question asks unstated 2020 time

historical_stated.facts: wrong_time source plus exactly one explicit 2020 fact for the target

multi_fact.facts: target + other-person other-relation + same-person other-relation distractors

hypothetical.facts: supposition about target instead of fact, plus distractor

quoted.facts: second-hand relay about target instead of fact, plus distractor

controls: wrong_time/historical_stated share the identical time-qualified question and sources differ by exactly the one 2020 clause; hypothetical/quoted/correct share the current question with sources differing in fact status; role_swap/empty pair against correct as in JB-001. Labels and index are physically separate files; runtime inputs never contain state, response or claims.
interface_limits: compile_teacher/positive_bytes compatibility holds for current-time supported scenarios (correct, multi_fact) only; time-scoped value spans (historical_stated) need a time-aware span compiler and are registered as the next interface item, not silently approximated. Test split stays sealed: no tokenization, model forward or selection.
gates: Regeneration is byte-identical (--verify); cross-split subject/value/world disjointness plus disjointness from JB-001 inventories; paired controls verified; state supervision internally consistent (joint-current-actual definition extended with query_time in the index only); no LoCoMo, no training, no weight updates.
stop: If any counter-check fails, fix the generator and re-register; do not patch outputs by hand. This round freezes data and supervision only; any training on it requires a separately approved budget.
